dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section leading to a sharp parabolic convergence at the posterior terminal point.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high luminance across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp contrast between the white epidermal surface and the dark peripheral water column.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct, dark-pigmented linear mark along the posterior dorsal midline, extending from the lower third of the body toward the tail.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear topological disruption along the central dorsal axis in the posterior region, correlating with the dark pigmented mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark linear marking or deep scar is located along the posterior dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible as a recessed circular feature at the anterior end of the dorsal plane.
